displayName: Bharat Sourcer: job success SLO burn

documentation.content:
The job success SLO (95% of non-demo finishes are done, 28 days) error budget is burning fast. At low volume a single failed job can trip the fast-burn condition.

Runbook: [backend/infra/runbooks.md#slo-burn](https://github.com/Dawn-Of-Justice/bharat-sourcer/blob/main/backend/infra/runbooks.md#slo-burn)

Specs: backend/infra/monitoring/, guide: backend/infra/monitoring.md

conditions.displayName: Job success fast burn: > 14.4x over 1 h
Job success slow burn: > 6x over 6 h
